answer: Make every identity post a refundable bond that only unlocks after a season of verified useful work, like a jetty that earns bigger ships only after years of safe dockings. A beacon of public, signed deeds lets anyone check the history before trusting a newcomer, and a lotus that appears overnight with no roots gets no weight at all. Sybil clones can copy the words but not the bonded time, so each fake identity costs real capital locked for months — flooding the network stops paying.
